claims.experiment: Moment maps and PV diagrams of CO, SiO and SO

claims.finding: CO traces four distinct regions of the outflow system

evidence.quote: the CO line traces four distinct regions: (1) an outer outflow shell, (2) a rotating wind region between the SiO and CO shells

claims.hypothesis: The CO rotating wind between the CO and SiO shells is an MHD disk wind with a launching radius and lever arm consistent with earlier SO results
claims.experiment: Ellipse fits to perpendicular PV diagrams at the 2-sigma level, then Anderson2003 and Blandford-Payne relations
claims.result: Low-velocity (red) ellipses give launching radii ~9-15 au and lambda ~3-4.5; high-velocity (brown) ellipses give ~1-2 au and lambda ~2-2.5
claims.finding: The CO rotating wind is consistent with an MHD disk wind launched slightly exterior to the SO shell; the high-velocity component is more likely a shocked wind

evidence.quote: The rotating wind, which is shocked, is launched from a radius of $9-15\,\mathrm{au}$
this emission is likely associated with a shocked wind, as a result of the interaction between the jet or wide-angle X-wind with the surrounding

claims.hypothesis: The CO jet knots show regular spacing, indicating episodic ejection
claims.experiment: Gaussian-fit knot positions and widths, with spacing converted to timescales using the jet velocity
claims.result: Ejections every 140 +/- 14 au (5.2 +/- 0.6 yr) with knots inside each ejection separated by 49 +/- 13 au (1.8 +/- 0.4 yr)
claims.finding: The CO jet is traced by a chain of knots with roughly equal intervals, exhibiting quasi-periodicity

evidence.quote: The CO jet is traced by a chain of knots with roughly equal interval, exhibiting quasi-periodicity

claims.hypothesis: What produces the CO outer outflow shell?

referee_caveats_inferred: Launching radii and lambda rest on ellipse fits to 2-sigma contours with no stated fitting algorithm, and the red and brown ellipse sets differ by a factor of ~5-10 in launching radius, so the result depends on an arbitrary choice of velocity range
Uncertainties on launching radius and lambda are not given; only ranges are quoted
Ellipse parameter table has incomplete headers and mixes columns, so the numbers cannot be cross-checked from the text
Three datasets of different cycles and baselines enter the CO image but the combination method and uv-range matching are not described
The unified-model versus disk-wind discrimination is argued qualitatively, not tested against simulated PV diagrams
Single-dish or short-spacing recovery for extended CO (outer shell, cloud absorption) is not discussed
